verses.text: Yahweh spoke to Moses: 📜
“Bring Aaron and his sons, their garments, the anointing oil, the sin-offering bull, both rams, and the basket of unleavened bread. 👘
“Gather the whole community at the Meeting Tent entrance.” 📣
Moses did what Yahweh commanded, and the community gathered at the Meeting Tent entrance. 👥
Moses told the community, “This is what Yahweh commanded us to do.” 📜
Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and washed them with water. 💧
He dressed Aaron in the tunic, tied the sash around him, put on the robe and ephod, then secured the ephod’s woven waistband. 👘
He placed the chest piece on Aaron and put the Urim and Thummim inside it. 💎
He set the turban on Aaron’s head and placed the gold plate—the sacred crown—at its front, just as Yahweh commanded Moses. 👑
Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the Dwelling and everything in it, setting them apart as holy. 🫙
He sprinkled oil on the altar seven times. He anointed the altar, all its tools, the basin, and its stand to set them apart. 7️⃣
He poured anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him, setting him apart. 🫙
Moses brought Aaron’s sons forward, dressed them in tunics, tied sashes around them, and put headbands on them, just as Yahweh commanded. 👕
Moses brought the sin-offering bull. Aaron and his sons placed their hands on its head. 🐂
Moses slaughtered it, dipped his finger in the blood, and put blood around the altar’s horns to purify it. He poured the rest at the altar’s base and set it apart, making atonement for it. 🩸
He took all the fat from the inner parts, the liver’s covering, and both kidneys with their fat, then burned them on the altar. 🔥
But he burned the bull—its hide, meat, and dung—outside the camp, exactly as Yahweh commanded Moses. 🔥
Moses brought the burnt-offering ram. Aaron and his sons placed their hands on its head. 🐏
Moses slaughtered the ram and splashed its blood all around the altar. 🩸
He cut the ram into pieces, and Moses burned the head, the pieces, and the fat. 🔥
He washed the inner parts and legs with water, then Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a pleasing burnt offering by fire to Yahweh, just as he commanded. 💧
Moses brought the second ram—the ordination ram. Aaron and his sons placed their hands on its head. 🐏
Moses slaughtered it, took some blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, his right thumb, and his right big toe. 🩸
He brought Aaron’s sons forward and put blood on the tip of each man’s right ear, right thumb, and right big toe. Then Moses splashed blood all around the altar. 🩸
He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat on the inner parts, the liver’s covering, both kidneys with their fat, and the right thigh; 🐏
then from the basket before Yahweh he took one unleavened loaf, one oil-mixed cake, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and right thigh. 🍞
He put all of it into Aaron’s hands and his sons’ hands, and they lifted it before Yahweh as a presentation offering. 🙌
Moses took the offering back from their hands and burned it on the altar with the burnt offering. It was their ordination offering, a pleasing fire offering to Yahweh. 🔥
Moses took the breast and lifted it before Yahweh as a presentation offering. That was Moses’ share of the ordination ram, just as Yahweh commanded. 🙌
Moses took anointing oil and some altar blood and sprinkled it on Aaron, his garments, his sons, and their garments. That set Aaron and all their clothes apart as holy. 🕊️
Moses told Aaron and his sons, “Boil the meat at the Meeting Tent entrance, then eat it there with the bread from the ordination basket. I was commanded: ‘Aaron and his sons must eat it.’ 🍲
“Burn whatever meat and bread are left over. 🔥
“Don’t leave the Meeting Tent entrance for seven days, until your ordination is complete. Your ordination takes seven days. 🗓️
“Yahweh commanded us to do everything we did today to make atonement for you. 🕊️
“Stay at the Meeting Tent entrance day and night for seven days and keep Yahweh’s command, so you don’t die. That’s what I was told.” ⚠️
Aaron and his sons did everything Yahweh had commanded through Moses. ✅
